seo.title: Colby Skirving | Electrical & Computer Engineering
seo.description: Portfolio of Colby Skirving, a final-year Electrical and Computer Engineering student at the University of Cape Town, focused on AI, automation, embedded systems and practical engineering design.

header.tagline: Electrical & Computer Engineering student building practical AI, automation and embedded-systems solutions.

paragraphs: I am a final-year BSc (Eng) Electrical and Computer Engineering student at the University of Cape Town, expecting to complete my degree in December 2026. My final-year average to date is 80.65%, and I was named to the Dean's List in my third year.

My interests include practical engineering design, AI and automation, embedded systems, computer systems and applied mathematics. I hold British and South African citizenship and will be available for work from January 2027.
Outside engineering, I play water polo, participate in social squash and enjoy good coffee.

items.name: TumorTrace — AI Medical Imaging Venture
description: Created a medtech company and product concept called TumorTrace through the EDHE Entrepreneurial Competition.
Developed an AI-based approach to identify tumours in medical images and classify them as malignant or benign.
Applied machine-learning and medical-imaging concepts to a practical diagnostic-support problem.

items.name: Formula Student South Africa — CAN Bus Sub-team
description: Founding member of the University of Cape Town Formula Student South Africa team.
Led the CAN bus sub-team, contributing to the vehicle communication-system workstream.
Developed experience in collaborative systems engineering within a student motorsport project.

items.name: Automated Cable Schedule Generation
description: Built a MATLAB script during vacation work at HATCH Engineering to automate cable-schedule generation.
The script supported the cooling-tower scope of a platinum mine project in Zimbabwe.
Received an award for this automation work; also contributed to load lists and lighting diagrams.

items.name: Portfolio Website
description: A responsive engineering portfolio built with vanilla JavaScript and JSON-driven content.
Includes dynamic content loading, GitHub integration and dark/light mode support.
Designed as a central place for technical projects, experience and code repositories.

responsibilities: Completed six weeks of vacation work at the HATCH Engineering offices in Johannesburg.
Developed an award-winning MATLAB script to automate cable-schedule generation for a platinum-mine cooling tower in Zimbabwe.
Created load lists and lighting diagrams for engineering deliverables.
Supported students alongside final-year engineering studies.
Coached the U14A and U15A boys' water polo teams.
Helped the teams achieve gold at a local schools tournament.
